canonicalAssertions.assertion: Given independent Hermes and CLI grants, when both refresh repeatedly, each remains usable; any failure produces secure recovery without token copying.
Given Toy's own ChatGPT login, when builder Codex credentials are unavailable or replaced in a test fixture, Toy refreshes and runs independently without reading the builder store.

assignedRungRequirements.requiredBehavior: Run separately registered real Hermes auth-add/refresh/chat and supported CLI-route login/use subprocesses, each in its own temporary scope. Exercise independent fake grants, repeated expiry/rotation, dead-grant recovery/reauthentication, and lost-response/restart. Independently read provider identity/generation and recovery state; do not copy tokens. Actual supported-account certification remains a separate protected prerequisite; SIM cannot log in or rotate another application's administrative grant.
assignedRungRequirements.cliRunAndReadback: Run each original whole AT through toy probe run and independently retrieve its exact operation with probe show. No new AT ID or case selector.

hermesAuth.currentPublicBehavior: The owner launches the pinned Hermes executable in temporary HOME/HERMES_HOME scopes and the fixture drives real public Hermes auth-add/list/chat subprocesses against fake OAuth/model endpoints. It already records sanitized process identity, provider ledger, generation, fresh-process usability and store digests; the expired-chat path exercises a refresh and reload.
hermesAuth.scope: This reaches the Hermes-owned grant only. Current auth-fixture operations do not provide the separate Codex CLI grant store.

codexCliRoute.localRouteInterface: ModelRoute.delegationReceipt accepts a CodexDelegationExecutor callback returning route/output/usage events.
codexCliRoute.fakeProbeBehavior: model-route-probe supplies a synthetic executor that yields fixture events; it does not spawn a Codex login/use process or persist and refresh a CLI grant.
codexCliRoute.opsInspector: inspectCodexProtocol examines the app-server schema surface with a temporary CODEX_HOME; its receipt sets authorizationInspected=false and inferenceAttested=false. It does not perform login, refresh or model use.
codexCliRoute.finding: No existing local public fake seam was found that runs the selected supported Codex CLI login/use subprocess in an isolated auth home and controls fake auth refresh, expiry and recovery responses. The ModelRoute executor cannot stand in for this assigned subprocess.

currentOwnerRegistration.acceptanceIndex: Both original AT IDs are indexed at CLI with the assertion hashes above.
currentOwnerRegistration.ownerScenario: The generated owner manifest has existing auth.first-add and auth.manual-lineage scenarios but no auth.independent-scopes scenario.
currentOwnerRegistration.dispatch: cli/src/main.ts and packages/hermes/src/auth-probe.ts dispatch the existing Hermes auth IDs but omit AT-hermes-config-36 and AT-ops-14. The two assigned IDs are therefore not runnable through the existing Hermes owner route.

decision.smallestExistingPublicSeam: Use the existing toy probe.run/probe.show boundary and HermesAuthProbe owner for the Hermes grant. Reuse its fake OAuth/model provider and sanitized readbacks; do not make another Hermes auth harness or rerun AT34/AT35.
decision.sourceReadiness: Not ready. The assigned second half requires a real supported CLI-route login/use subprocess with its own temporary scope and independently fakeable external auth/model responses. Existing ModelRoute and Ops Codex interfaces do not reach that behavior.
decision.precisePrerequisiteBeforeSource: R0.01 must select and pin the supported CLI route and expose its real public login/use subprocess contract for a disposable CODEX_HOME with synthetic external auth/model responses, refresh/rotation controls, and sanitized fresh-process identity/generation/recovery readbacks. If no such supported subprocess seam exists, stop and separately review the minimum test seam needed at that external provider boundary; do not substitute a fake executor, inspect/seed a private store, copy a token, or perform actual account login.
minimumConditionalSourceScope: Register one auth.independent-scopes scenario for the two existing AT IDs and route both through the current public HermesAuthProbe owner; add no AT ID.

Reuse the existing Hermes fixture for the Hermes auth-add/refresh/chat process in its own temporary scope; invoke the selected supported CLI login/use subprocess in a second temporary scope only after its public fake seam is evidenced.

Capture repeated rotation, dead-grant secure recovery and reauthentication, lost-response/restart, fresh-process usability, and independent nonsecret provider identity/generation readbacks. Preserve no-token-copy and sanitized-output constraints.

Use the existing bounded owner result unless it cannot express a required observation; no database, public API, or DTO change is currently justified. Update the existing registry/owner route and feature map from their sources if admitted; do not hand-edit generated output.
otherPrerequisites: A fresh normal-pressure memory admission at source admission time.
No concurrent SOURCE/LIVE owner and a current pin review; do not reuse historical pre-AT35 source hashes.
Actual supported-account consent, Keychain ownership and live account certification remain separately protected and cannot be inferred from synthetic fixtures.
decision.priority: Do not reopen AT34 or AT35. A valid ROOT-R004-20261006-02 DONE remains parent-prioritized for R0.01 after cleanup.
